Concurrently, HUD withdrew the ‘continuing violation’ interpretation of the Fair Housing Act’s design‑and‑construction requirements, affecting new housing compliance, and the EU introduced proposed public procurement rules to promote inclusive practices across infrastructure, transport, digital services and products. Technology advances included Apple’s iOS 27 accessibility features, AI‑powered tools showcased at FIAA 2026, and new apps receiving accessibility certification.

en.title: Federal Transit Funding Boost and Disability Benefit Launch Highlight Week's Accessibility Progress
en.summary: The Federal Transit Administration announced $233 million in grants to improve accessibility at transit stations nationwide, marking the week's largest funding commitment. Earlier, Canada began issuing Disability Benefit payments in September to reduce financial barriers for persons with disabilities, and SEPTA received an $80 million federal grant to upgrade three trolley stations for ADA compliance. Additionally, the EU State of the Union address highlighted gaps in disability accessibility measures, while various tech and arts initiatives advanced accessibility.
